$comment: Spec for the dispatcher end-to-end differential (W4.1d batch 1). One character + one chat with a message corpus + an EMPTY chat (no events) + a seed annotation, then a mixed batch of tool calls driven through v4's REAL executeToolCallWithContext (oracle) vs the Rust BuiltInToolRunner. Proves dispatch + handler + harness compose for a read, two writes (with dispatcher character-name resolution), a pure tool, a handler failure, and an invalid-input failure. All ids are valid UUIDs (the characters/chats schemas validate them). P4.D235 (v4 f7f3d7bf0): read_conversation / upsert_annotation render the transcript LIVE from the messages (chats.renderedMarkdown is gone); the oracle freezes `Date` at `nowIso`, and the Rust side normalizes the one `Current time:` header line (its dispatcher reads the real clock; the byte-exact frozen-clock render is scriptorium_tools').

Hello from the vault.

ops.$comment: write — upsert on message 0 (create); the dispatcher must resolve characterName='Friday' from callingParticipantId.
write — upsert on message 1 (update; the seed annotation exists for Friday).

args.content: an updated note replacing the seed

ops.$comment: handler failure — read_conversation on a chat with NO events → 'Conversation has no messages to read yet.' (P4.D235: was 'Conversation has not been rendered yet.')
invalid input — help_navigate with an off-allowlist url → the exact Zod failure.
wardrobe_list — W4.1d batch 2: the ported wardrobe dispatch row; empty vault → no items (real handler both sides, no minted values).
doc_read_file — W4.1d batch 3b: the ported doc-edit dispatch row; reads the seeded file in Friday's own (transparent) vault. Deterministic (both read the same fixture), no minted values.
doc_read_frontmatter — a second doc-edit dispatch row; reads the seeded file's YAML frontmatter.

list_images (W4.9b) — a photo-trio dispatch row on Friday's own vault; the album is empty, so the handler returns the empty listing. Proves the photo dispatch wiring end-to-end (no baked photos / no embedding needed for an empty-query listing).

generate_image (W4.9a) — the dispatch row proving generate_image is wired. No imageProfileId is set on the context, so v4's dispatcher guard (`if (!imageProfileId)`) and the Rust runner's default ErasedImageGeneration::none() both return the byte-identical 'not enabled' failure — no image subsystem needed.

P4.D108 (v4 a14a1811 bug 92) — describe_image dispatch: an unresolvable uuid answers the byte-exact No-image sentence through the real handler (proves the dispatch arm end-to-end; the fixture holds no image rows, so resolution legitimately fails on both sides).

P4.124 (P4.D234 NIT) — the retired `list_email` name (v4 `39bc98ffc` renamed it `list_mail`) reaches v4's unknown-tool return: the tsx oracle's tool registry is empty, so the plugin branch is skipped and v4 answers `Unknown tool: list_email`; v5's `LoudFallbackRunner` must answer the same bytes (not its 'recognized but not yet available' arm).
